weather.note: Open-Meteo forecasts: GFS, ECMWF IFS, ICON, NBM. IVT from GFS winds and humidity, 1000 to 300 hPa; AR scale after Ralph et al. (2019), on hourly IVT. Past hours show each model's newest archived value for that hour. Hours are UTC; fetched 2026-11-21 21:41Z.

live.source: CDEC SCC, 24-h mean of hourly computed inflow, centred on the hour
